entries.title: Rice field (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of rice field inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Rice is grown in flooded, levee-edged fields in parts of Louisiana; after harvest many fields are re-flooded to raise crawfish (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Sugarcane harvest (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of sugarcane harvest inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Sugarcane is a major Louisiana crop harvested in the cooler months and milled soon after cutting (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Strawberry picking (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of strawberry picking inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Strawberries are grown in parts of south-east Louisiana and picked by hand when fully red (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Satsuma-style citrus harvest (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of satsuma-style citrus harvest inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Satsuma-type mandarins grow in south Louisiana and are clipped rather than pulled so the peel is not torn (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Pecan gathering (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of pecan gathering inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Pecan trees are native to the region; the nuts fall in autumn and are gathered from the ground (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Garden plot (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of garden plot inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: The Gulf Coast has two main vegetable-garden seasons, spring and autumn, with hot summers in between (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Orchard harvest (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of orchard harvest inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Orchards of stone fruit and apples are part of the farmland around the Bay Area; fruit is picked by hand as it ripens (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Vineyard-style harvest (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of vineyard-style harvest inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Grapes are grown in the valleys north of the Bay and picked in late summer and autumn (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Community garden (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of community garden inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: The Bay Area has a mild climate, so community gardens can grow something in most months (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: Shoreline cleanup day (harvest)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of shoreline cleanup day inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Volunteer shoreline cleanups keep litter out of the Bay and record what they find (source kind: state coastal agency).

entries.title: Parade season (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of parade season inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Winter parade season is a long community tradition in south Louisiana towns (source kind: local tourism office).

entries.title: Festival day (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of festival day inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Many Louisiana towns hold food and music festivals in the mild spring and autumn months (source kind: local tourism office).

entries.title: Hurricane-preparedness drill (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of hurricane-preparedness drill inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: The Gulf Coast plans for hurricanes every summer and autumn; official seasons and alerts come from the national weather service and local emergency management (source kind: national weather service).

entries.title: Back-to-school week (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of back-to-school week inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: In the southern states school usually starts in late summer, in the heat (source kind: local school district calendar).

entries.title: Festival day (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of festival day inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Bay Area towns hold street fairs and harvest festivals through the dry months (source kind: local tourism office).

entries.title: Earthquake-preparedness drill (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of earthquake-preparedness drill inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: The Bay Area lies near active faults, so schools and families practise drop, cover and hold on (source kind: state emergency services office).

entries.title: Back-to-school week (seasonal event)
entries.hint: Seasons & harvest panel: finish every step of back-to-school week inside its windows (approximate, game calendar).
entries.reveal: Many California schools start in August (source kind: local school district calendar).

entries.title: A rice season, flood to harvest
entries.hint: Take one rice field through all six stages: field prep, flooding, planting, growth, draining and harvest.
entries.reveal: After the rice harvest, many Louisiana fields are re-flooded for crawfish - the rice-crawfish rotation (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: A Louisiana growing year
entries.hint: Harvest every Louisiana crop in the game calendar at least once.
entries.reveal: Louisiana crops follow warm-season and cool-season rhythms; extension services publish planting calendars for each region (source kind: state agricultural extension service).

entries.title: A Bay Area growing year
entries.hint: Finish the orchard, vineyard, community garden and shoreline cleanup tasks in the Bay game calendar.
entries.reveal: The Bay Area mild, dry-summer climate shapes when fruit ripens and when gardens are watered (source kind: state agricultural extension service).
